question: Who was the mascot for the 2020 National Games of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rubigula, the Flame-Throated Bulbul.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rubigula **is a **bird species** native to the **Western Ghats**, which is a **mountain range** in India and a biodiversity hotspot.
 
• The choice of Rubigula as the mascot reflects the importance of **preserving India's rich natural heritage.**
 
• The Flame-Throated Bulbul is known for its** distinctive red throat,** which symbolizes the **spirit of the games** and the **passion of the athletes.**
 
• The choice of Rubigula as the mascot also highlights the** need for conservation efforts** to protect endangered species like this bird.
 
• The mascot design for Rubigula was created by a **12-year-old girl **named **Vedashree Khambete** from **Maharashtra,** through a nationwide competition.
 
• This reflects the spirit of **inclusivity and youth empowerment** that the National Games aim to promote.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ammu, the great hornbill** was the mascot for the **2015 National Games of India**, which were held in** Kerala.**
 
• **Maharashtra** emerged victorious in the** 37th National Games**, which took place in **Goa** from **October 26 to November 9,** 2023, with **228 medals,** comprising 80 gold, 69 silver, and 79 bronze.
 
• With **126 medals,** including 66 gold, 27 silver, and 33 bronze, **Services** came in second.
